Name: FriendshipProgressionTweaker
Author: SoraHolmes
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]FriendshipProgressionTweaker[/size][/b] lets you customize how quickly friendship points are gained in Stardew Valley.

Instead of using one multiplier for every friendship level, the mod allows you to set separate percentages for each two-heart range:

- 0–2 hearts
- 2–4 hearts
- 4–6 hearts
- 6–8 hearts
- 8–10 hearts
- 10–12 hearts
- 12–14 hearts

Separate scaling options are available for:

- Gifts
- Conversations
- Quests
- Events

This makes it possible to slow friendship progression down gradually, keep the early stages more generous, or create your own progression balance.


[b][size=5]Tested Features[/size][/b]

The following friendship sources have been tested in-game:

- Regular conversations
- Regular gifts
- Birthday gifts
- Help Wanted board item-delivery quests
- Item-delivery quests received by letter
- Weekly Special Orders

Each tested source correctly uses its own configured category and the percentage for the NPC's current heart range.

[color=#ff0000]Event friendship[/color] scaling is included in the configuration, but [color=#ff0000]has not yet been fully tested[/color] and should currently be considered experimental.



[b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional)  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url], press F2 on NPC to see if mod works as intended / fn+F1 on laptop[/color]
(can be used to check an NPC's exact friendship points before and after an interaction because SMAPI shows Vanilla points) [/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Gaining a Friendship Points via Milestone/Progression/Scaler per 2 Hearts with adjustable percentage from Gifting, Talking, Quest and Event (like dialogue choices or special days).[/color][/size]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]A Note from the Original Creator ( Why This Mod Exists)[/size][/color][/b]
I don't know which head or tail about programming/coding, that's why, with the help of ChatGPT (yeah, I know) and inspired by a Mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24389?tab=posts]DifficultySocializing[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PokeBenji]PokeBenji[/url], this mod could exist. Only beginning to play Stardew Valley, realizing that friendship points gained by gifting (more so on birthday and gold quality stuff), like way too much by my standard, raising it from 2 hearts to 5 hearts, just like that was already done within 2 weeks in Spring. Year 1. I'm thinking, "No, I thought this game had the definition of cozy, but that doesn't align with you, taking your time, that later on the NPC will just become a husk."

Searching mod on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/]Nexus Mods[/url], trying to find with the name "Progression","Scaling","Friendship","Points","Hearts""Social", the result??? so little, almost none that fit my needs. There was mod that make friendship easier, or improve UI on them, or others. The similiar mod compare what I have now, the closest one is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17055]Friendship Tweaks[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24389?tab=posts]DifficultySocializing[/url], the former have what I have in mind but no scaling while the latter one was outated (I think?), because the scale option doesn't work anymore for me and you can't setting in-game and only on the menu (while mine works both).

So, that's why this mod was born from scratch with 0% skill on both programming and coding, never use Visual Studio or SMAPI, never use ChatGPT before, not good at English or making a statement, or using this GitHub website, I was desperate to make a Friendship Progression/Scaler Percentage every 2 Hearts Mods (MOUTHful).

Downloads.Description:
Fixes friendship scaling for conversations, gifts, Help Wanted item-delivery quests, and item-delivery quests received by letter.

Heart-event friendship changes have not been tested yet.
